description: finger joint press machine MH1325 from Shang Rui Machinery. table size 3200×1300mm, working stroke 400mm, main cylinder 15TJoins short offcuts into long continuous panels with strong finger joints, raising material utilisation and cutting waste. Supplied by Shang Rui Machinery with CE certification on core models, technical support and lifetime spare parts availability.

faq.q: What board size does the Splicing Machine MH1325 handle?
faq.a: The working table measures 3200×1300mm, covering the common panel widths used in furniture and solid wood production.
The main cylinder delivers 15T with a secondary cylinder at 30T, giving even pressure across the full joint length.

faq.q: How does it improve material usage?
faq.a: Short offcuts are joined end to end into full-length panels, so a factory can use stock it would otherwise scrap. The working stroke is 400mm.

faq.q: Can it run as part of an automatic finger joint line?
faq.a: Yes. It is designed to sit in a finger joint line with a shaper, glue unit, conveyor and cut-off saw, and we can supply the complete line.
